findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.citation_text:
5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing.

On arrival the hand sink behind the bar had multiple items in it. Education was conducted with the PIC and the sink emptied to correct. Ensure that all hand sinks are maintained free of obstructions and available for use as a hand sinks at all times.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.citation_text:
3-307.11 Miscellaneous Sources of Contamination. FOOD shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 - 3-306. 

Multiple bottles of Skinny Mixes are observed with small mold colonies growing on the outside of the containers. The PIC was shown and discarded them to correct.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.citation_text:
4-302.14 Sanitizing Solutions, Testing Devices. A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

The available test strips have all expired in the spring of last year. The PIC was shown and instructed to acquire new test strips prior to the follow up in 10 days.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

1) Sections of the ceiling are observed damaged/missing during this inspection. PIC indicated that the plan is to have them replace around March. 2) A small section of the floor behind the bar is observed with laminate pulling up. The PIC is instructed to repair prior to the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Food handler training
findings.comment:
(REPEAT x3) 410 ILCS 625/3.06(b). Food handler training: restaurants. (b) Unless otherwise provided, all food handlers employed by a restaurant, other than someone holding a food service sanitation manager certificate, must receive or obtain American National Standards Institute-accredited training in basic safe food handling principles within 30 days after employment and every 3 years thereafter. 

The employee/PIC for this facility has not competed food handler training at the time of this inspection. Education was conducted and they are instructed to complete the training and maintain a copy of the certificate moving forward. Putting “Illinois Food Handler Certification” into google should pull up multiple option to complete this. This was shown to the PIC during this inspection.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Inspector observed area along the back of the 3 part sink to be soiled. Clean and maintain the area free of accumulated soil. 

6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment:
Discussed need for licensure due to ice handling and making mixed drinks. Complete licensure before next routine inspection. Keep copy at the facility.

410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430 (C) Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. 

(REPEAT) Observed no test strips for quaternary ammonium. Purchase test strips. Quat is used at the 3 compartment sink at the bar. Test strips for bleach available. Inspector will follow-up on 12/27/21 (longer than 10 days due to Christmas holiday). This is a repeat violation since the last routine inspection on 2/3/17.

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment:
410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430 (C) Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement.  

Observed no food handler’s license for the owner/only employee. Discussed need for licensure due to ice handling and slicing of fruits. Complete licensure before next routine inspection. Keep copy at the facility.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Observed an open orange juice with a keep refrigerated after opening label. No date mark was observed on the bottle. Owner was allowed to place date mark on the OJ for 2 days prior. This is the date the owner stated it was opened. 
750-151(a) Refrigerated potentially hazardous ready to eat food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the date or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
Observed excessive amounts of personal food being stored over beer within the ice chest. This food was not stored in a sealed container, but in to-go containers. Ensure that personal food is being stored below and away from service food and drinks. Owner moved the personal food.
750-160  Food shall be protected at all times from cross-contamination.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed multiple areas where drinks were being stored on the floor. Ensure that food and drinks are stored at least 6 inches off the floor to protect them. 
750-130(b) Food shall be stored at least 6 inches off the floor.  Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
Observed no test kit available at the facility for testing the concentration of the sanitizer. Ensure that a test kit is purchased to adequately test the sanitizer before using for service.
750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed the pizza ovens (3) to have an excessive accumulation of food debris on the inside. Ensure that food contact surfaces are washed, rinsed, and sanitized following each use.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
1) Observed multiple points throughout the facility where the plaster is crumbling off the wall, specifically in areas where alcohol is stored. 2) Also noted the paint peeling away from the wall in the lobby area. 3) The wood paneling behind the bar is beginning to peel away from the wall. 4) Observed the ceilings throughout the facility to be missing pieces of tile. This allows for the bare wood of the structure to be exposed. Ensure that wall, ceilings, and attached fixtures are maintained in good repair, as well as in a clean state.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
Observed multiple areas where personal items are being stored. The owner states he hasn't had a chance to take stuff to his house. The amount of articles makes it difficult to navigate the area around the pizza ovens. Ensure that all personal items are removed from the facility. 
750-1350c Only articles necessary for the operation and maintenance of the food service establishment shall be stored on the premises.  Remove all unnecessary items.
750-1390 Maintenance and cleaning tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners and similiar equipment shall be maintained and stored in a way that does not contaminate food.
750-1160 The premises shall be kept in such a condition to prevent the harborage or feeding of insects or rodents.
750-1350a Food service establishments and all parts of property used in connection with their operation shall be kept free of litter.  Remove all unnecessary items.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed that 2 of the 3 ovens to bake frozen pizzas have some build up of baked on debris.
750-800b. All food-contact-surfaces shall be properly cleaned and sanitized .
Clean the ovens.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment: Three bottles of juice are observed on the bar top upon arrival.  The juice is at room temperature and the seals have been opened. 750-120(a) Potentially hazardous foods, shall be maintained at a proper product temperature at all times during storage (41°F or below, or 135°F or above)The juice was poured down the drain and bottles recycled. They were individual portion size juice bottles.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment: No test kit for the sanitizer is present at the facility. 750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million. Provide test kit so that the sanitizer can be verified to be to proper concentration of chemical as required. Product in facility is a quat based sanitizer.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: The pizza ovens are soiled with food debris. 750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use and any time they may have become contaminated.  Properly wash rinse and sanitize the pizza oven racks and drip trays.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment: Three crock pots are observed in the back room. 750-1350c Only articles necessary for the operation and maintenance of the food service establishment shall be stored on the premises.  Remove all unnecessary items.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: Did not observe a thermometer in the single door glass front cooler.  Provide a thermometer in the cooler.
findings.citation_text: 750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed raw wood at the backside of the bar.  Paint the wood a light color or use a clear seal.
750-600 Non-food contact surfaces shall be smooth and easily cleanable

findings.title: Cross-connections, back-siphonage, back-flow prevented
findings.comment:
Did not observe an air gap for the ice bin.  Provide an air gap of at least two inches to prevent backflow from the sewer line.
750-290 Ice storage bins shall be drained through an air gap. Provide an air gap.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
Repeat:  Did not observe a self-closing device on the bathroom door.  Provide a self-closing bathroom door.
750-1120 All restrooms must have self-closing doors, properly operating fixtures, be clean and have proper hand washing supplies in order to help facilitate good hygienic practices.  Provide properly designed and maintained restrooms.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.comment:
The back door, neither the solid or screen door, are self-closing or tight-fitting.  One of the doors must be self-closing and tight-fitting.
750-1170 Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects.
